text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehhー! We went through the trouble of getting them, let's wear them~!
Let's head out in our "BNW Jumpers"~!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Oh? That is...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No way. Impossible. Walking around wearing something with 'BNW' written ginormously on the back?
...What were our moms even thinking?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Well, I can understand Taishin's reluctance.
If only she could pull off wearing it well, though...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: —Coordinating matching outfits is difficult, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
“Still, as long as you grasp the key points, you'll be fine!
If you'd like, I'd be happy to hear you out♪”

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It's Flight!
Taishin, Taishin! Our savior is here!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That is reassuring. ...About this windbreaker, though,
our mothers inexplicably got all excited and sent it over.
I wonder if the three of us will each be able to pull off wearing it?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Wah, lovely! The simple black fabric
really makes the logo on the back pop...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yet to put it the other way around...
it means standing out just as much.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Plus, if we wear them the same way,
that'll be 'matching' too, making us stand out even more."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Then! How about changing how you wear it
to match each individual 'material'?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
For example! In Taishin-san's case,
you could tie it around your waist like your racing silks.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
If it's for Hayahide-san, I'd try incorporating it
into her casual clothes, like wearing it sash-style across the shoulder.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
This way, the logo is visible without being too overbearing, making it a bit easier to wear!
...What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Well, in that case.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Really!? For real, for real!? Taishiiin!!
Flights are amazing! Thank you so much~~!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Not at all♪ If you'd like to buy some clothes to match the jacket, I'd be happy to go shopping with you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. I feel reassured if you're the one choosing.
However—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't that be a bit too much of a burden on you?
I'd like to repay you somehow, if possible.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! In that case, there's something
I'd like to consult everyone about too...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what is it!?
Sure thing!! Ask me anything!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
! Really?!
Actually—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Big sis... I've been agonizing over what color stole to get for our former teacher...!

text_block_list.name: BNW
text_block_list.text: The color... of the stole?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"No... Why don't you just pick based on your own taste?
You've got a real talent for that kind of thing."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... You're right, but
it's not that simple...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"It's definitely Luminous Coral!" was my first thought.
She makes such a wonderful, cheerful impression, so that's what I assumed, but...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Twilight Blue is just too good to give up on after all!
I just love that intellectual side of you at work so much...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I really can't decide, and I'm in such a bind...!
Could I ask for your advice...?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. I see, so that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*Sob* *waaah*!
Flight, you really love that teacher of yours, don't you~!
I'll think of something with all my might!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
...I look forward to working with you, seniors!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On a rest day, I ran into North Flight and the others, who seemed to be heading out together.
choice_data_list: A stole as a present, huh? Nice!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes! So when I talked with the upperclassmen,
I thought it'd be nice to get matching ones as gifts.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Still... from an adult's perspective,
do you feel awkward about matching?"
choice_data_list: Seeing you two as "best buddies from the start" is so heartwarming.
I think something like 'A Special Proof' would be nice.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, did you hear that!? They said it was heartwarming!
I knew it, let's wear that jacket again today~~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Denied. Changing clothes is too much of a pain.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Thank you for your valuable input!
Now I can pick it out with confidence♪
choice_data_list: Ah, hope you find something good.
Yeah, hope you find a good one.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Special...! Someone special, huh...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. That was valuable input.
Now I can choose with confidence.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Thank you, Trainer!
choice_data_list: I hope you find something wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later.
North Flight beamed as she showed me a smiling photo of the two of them wearing matching stoles.
